# Tasks: Feature Focus Order

Five all-open canonical units implement the contract at `.dude/specs/024-feature-focus-order/spec.md`, owned exactly by `.dude/ideas/feature-focus-order.md`.

The design is one read-only script plus one enabling frontmatter-key change. If any task starts to add a new skill directory, a second board, a dependency engine, a scheduler, a writer for the optional ordering, a cross-feature task-dependency mechanism, a foreign-key guard, an HTML page, or any write path from `@dude status`, stop with `plan-gap` instead of building it. The plan's dropped-and-deferred list is the implementation boundary.

No task carries `[P]`. Each phase builds on the one before, so the tasks are intentionally sequential. Durable suffixes are fixed lowercase hexadecimal encodings of `keys`, `buck`, `draw`, `link`, and `gate`.

Core source lives under `src/`; `.github/` core is generated only by `node scripts/build-dev.mjs` and is never hand-edited.

Execution may read but must not write any `.dude/specs/024-feature-focus-order/**` artifact. No task may mutate another feature's package, task state, board, mirror, execution history, or Coordinator Log. `@dude status` and every focus surface stay read-only. A required normative change stops as `contract-mismatch: redefine-required`.
